## What this PR changes

- [ ] New project
- [ ] Edit to an existing project or profile
- [ ] Design / code change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally
- [ ] Screenshots are compressed (under ~300 KB each)
- [ ] "Who built what" is accurate and the other person agrees with it
- [ ] No API keys, passwords or private data in the diff
- [ ] Coursework is allowed to be shown publicly (or only screenshots/video are included)
